description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams' extending a base filter parameters class, used for specifying search filters related to internationalization import errors, including parameters like language ID and employee number.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters when searching for internationalization import errors, including sortable fields and specific filter attributes like language ID and employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the default sort field to 'importError.langString'.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used as a filter.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID used as a filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter.
